summary: Accepted the beneficiary relationship from AI infrastructure and power bottlenecks to Eaton with high positive sensitivity and medium confidence. Eaton's Q1 2026 filing shows direct transmission through data-centre orders, electrical backlog, segment revenue, margins, and operating cash flow, while customer concentration, capacity execution, acquisitions, leverage, working capital, order normalization, and adverse current valuation limit shareholder transmission. Updated the relationship page, catalog, log, and canonical relationship row; no strategy or follow-up operation was created before Q2 evidence and a valuation meeting the margin-of-safety gate.

evidence.claim: Eaton reported Q1 2026 sales of USD 7.451 billion and operating cash flow of USD 507 million; Electrical Americas data-centre orders rose about 240%, its sales rose 20% to USD 3.6 billion, rolling orders rose 42%, backlog rose 44%, and operating margin reached 25.6%, while Electrical Global sales rose 21%, backlog rose 73%, and margin reached 19.2%.

The maintained Eaton review records direct electrical and data-centre exposure, positive margins and cash conversion, USD 21.129 billion of debt after material acquisitions, and bounded downside and base values below the USD 398.64 market mark.

The maintained idea defines the causal channel from concentrated data-centre electricity demand through grid, switchgear, power-distribution, and thermal bottlenecks to qualified supplier orders, margins, and cash, with project delays, concentration, capacity additions, and valuation as explicit counterweights.

daily_report_items: Accepted the medium-confidence, high-sensitivity positive beneficiary relationship from AI infrastructure and power bottlenecks to Eaton based on data-centre orders, electrical backlog, segment revenue, margins, and cash conversion; no strategy follow-up was created because acquisition leverage, concentration, current valuation, and pending Q2 evidence remain limiting.
